about_the_game:
Ready to host a party game powered by your imagination?

Hardware Support

First things first, make sure your hardware can support it!
If you run the AIGM (AI Game Master) without supported hardware, generations will run on the CPU, which will consequently will take a significant amount of time!
With a supported Vulkan GPU, sending an empire action takes at most a minute.

name: Space Conquest AI - AIGM

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: AMD FX-8320 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 8GB+ VRAM is minimum to run local LLM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 16GB+ VRAM is recommended to run local LLM

short_description: The AIGM DLC is what you need to host Space Conquest AI games. It provides the ability to host a lobby, which means processing AI results. Your friends only need the FREE base game to be able to join!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
